episodes.207026: A low-topped squall line along a strong cold front produced numerous gale-force wind gusts.
episodes.207997: Thunderstorms produced strong wind gusts along the Brevard County coast near Cape Canaveral.
episodes.208390: A line of gusty showers along a cold front moved easts across the Chesapeake Bay and tidal rivers during the night of October 19 into the early morning hours of October 20. This resulted in a brief period of gusty winds across the Chesapeake Bay and tidal rivers.
episodes.208423: Returning tropical moisture with a stalling frontal boundary to the north of the waters provided an environment supportive of waterspout activity over the Atlantic waters on the afternoon of October 20, 2025.
